items.t: Clutch slipping or wearing out
items.note: Performance or multi-disc clutches cost much more. Flywheel resurfacing adds $100-300.

items.t: Clutch slave cylinder seal failure
items.job: Replace slave cylinder with clutch kit
items.note: The transmission has to come out, so the slave cylinder is usually done with the clutch.

items.t: Soft clutch pedal from leaking slave cylinder
items.job: Replace slave cylinder with clutch kit

items.t: Head gasket leaks on original gaskets
Power steering pump bracket cracks and assist is lost
items.job: Replace power steering pump and bracket
items.note: If only the bracket or pulley broke, the cost is much lower.

items.t: Steering rack mounting brackets can crack (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Rear differential mounting bracket welds can crack (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Optional racing harness may not be strong enough (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Catalytic converter failure
items.note: RepairPal shows 2003-2006 converters costing about $8,000 to replace, versus under $800 for 2008-2010.

items.t: Window regulator failure
Window drops wrong and hits the roof when the door closes
items.note: If nothing broke, a window position re-learn costs far less.

items.t: Oil leak from the front timing cover
Battery runs down when the car sits
items.note: A battery maintainer costs much less and helps prevent this.

items.t: Airbags can deploy on their own (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module and sensors (recalls 13V040000 / 15V046000)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Fuel pump wiring can chafe and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Wrap fuel pump harness and cover heat shield (recall 03V292000)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Headlights or dash lights flicker or fail (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Restraint control module can fire airbags unexpectedly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Water pump failure
Seat position sensor can make airbags deploy too softly (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Radio software could be hacked remotely (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Passenger airbag door can break loose (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Driver airbag wiring can be pinched (recall)
items.note: Free at a Dodge/Chrysler dealer if the recall was never done.

items.t: Clunk or click from the rear driveline
items.note: Often no repair is needed; some driveline clunk is normal on a Viper.
